edits.purpose: Remove unsolicited slogans and decorative writing from margins and books

acceptanceScope: All required title, header, time and subject data were manually reviewed in the final image; any cosmetic exception is explicitly listed.
limitations: Native resolution is below the prompt's aspirational 3508×2480 target. File is saved unchanged without upscaling or typesetting.
Illustration/title band takes approximately 21–23% of image height rather than the prompt's 20% design target.
